rows.notes: Same vendor-tree model and official v4.0.3 tag. They track quattro HEAD between tags and ship a UX VM suite on main. G1 desktop profile is thin (no Docker/Steam/zram-100/global allowUnfree); they still kitchen-sink by default. We win thin default, documented gaps, and stub honesty; we tie on official pin freshness; we lose on interim HEAD tracking and test depth.

Both vendor Omarchy 4.x with Nix-facing verbs. They brand a separate CLI; we keep omarchy-* pixels with omarchy-nix-* underneath and one NIX-VERBS page. Tie on verbs after G4; win on henrysipp disambiguation and COMPAT discipline.

Different product: Nix-native rice without live theme swap. We lose pixel_parity by choice (vendor port vs reimplementation). We win on trailing official tags, ledgers, Nix verbs, and metal/CI bar for people who want Arch Omarchy pixels.

Early reimplementation; author returned to Arch; repo is mindshare, not maintenance. We lose pixel_parity and GitHub search rank. We win on maintained vendor pin, ledgers, Nix verbs, and README that answers 'is this henrysipp?' on the first screen.
Thin presentation/OS boundary layer, not a full Omarchy vendor port. Not a direct substitute for sit-down Omarchy parity; compare on integration philosophy only.
